body:
# Nichelle Nichols

# Nichelle Nichols

# President of the Board of Education

![](/media/uploads/2026/01/nichols2.png)

- **[Equity consultant](https://www.nationalequityproject.org/team/nichelle-nichols)** for the National Equity Project
- Black Lives Matter supporter (**[insert this pic](https://www.facebook.com/photo/?fbid=10220440202068252&set=ecnf.1627471022)**)
- Advocates for every child to have a black teacher (**[insert pic](https://www.facebook.com/photo/?fbid=10223958102973576&set=a.2682577516809)**)
- Issued **[a statement](https://east.madison.k12.wi.us/families/district-news/district-news-article/~board/newsstories/post/superintendents-message-united-states-supreme-court-decisions)** on behalf of the school district expressing concern that the Supreme Court ruling ending affirmative action would “slow progress.”In a Jan. 2025 **[written statement](https://www.madison.k12.wi.us/about/news/article/~board/newsstories/post/statement-from-the-board-of-education-mmsds-commitment-to-educational-excellence-and-inclusion)**, Nichols reinforced resolutions adopted by the Board of education, including a resolution that **[supports](https://go.boarddocs.com/wi/mmsd/Board.nsf/files/C38J4T4B6834/$file/MMSD%20Trans%20Resolution.pdf)** transgender students participating in sports based on their gender identity/expression, not biological sex.
